citation: Sibley, C. G., et al. (2011). The Mini-IPIP6: Validation and extension of a short measure of the Big-Six factors of personality in New Zealand. New Zealand Journal of Psychology, 40, 142-159.
why_included: The sixth HEXACO factor (sincerity, fairness, greed avoidance, modesty). Adds what the Big Five misses on integrity and status/money motivation, which matters for lanes like sales, trading and creator work where incentives can conflict with honesty. Low score is not 'bad': it often tracks status and wealth motivation.

response_format.stem: How accurately does each statement describe you? Describe yourself as you generally are now, not as you wish to be, compared with people of your sex and roughly your age.

administration.order: Interleave into the personality block after item NEO060.

scoring.reverse: All four items are negatively keyed: score = 6 - response.

items.text: Feel entitled to more of everything.
Would like to be seen driving around in a very expensive car.
Would get a lot of pleasure from owning expensive luxury goods.
